newsitem.title: USA: St. Paul Bancorp approves stock split.
newsitem.headline: St. Paul Bancorp approves stock split.

text.p: St. Paul Bancorp Inc said on Monday its directors voted a five-for-four stock split of its outstanding shares.
The split is payable January 14 to shareholders of record on December 31.
The board of directors also voted to maintain St. Paul's regular quarterly cash dividend at $0.12 a share.

As a result, the company said it increased its post-split cash dividend payout by 25 percent. Shareholders will receive 25 percent more in dividends -- $0.60 annually on five shares rather than $0.48 on four shares.

St. Paul Bancorp is the parent of St. Paul Federal Bank For Savings, the largest independent savings bank in Illinois. It also provides discount brokerage, insurance, annuity and real estate development services through other subsidiaries.
St. Paul Bancorp shares closed up 1/8 to 27-3/4 in trading on the Nasdaq.
